body: Just checking: Should this not send notifications to `body_monitor_callback` and `area_monitor_callback`?

No, I thought so too, but since the scene node (i.e. the receiver of the callback) is going away anyway, ~~or worse yet, is being replaced by another scene node~~, any calls to that callback will either not happen (because nulled out callback or we got freed entirely) ~~or will happen to the wrong scene node~~.

So we should rightfully just wipe everything in this manner instead.

EDIT: I'm not sure the "replaced by another scene node" scenario is a valid one, now that I think more carefully about this. Either way, this is what Godot Physics seems to do as well.
